sloka: बाहून् उपनिधाय अन्याः पारिहार्य विभूषिताः ।अम्शुकानि च रम्याणि प्रमदाः तत्र शिश्यिरे ॥५-९-६०॥
transliteration: bāhūn upanidhāya anyāḥ pārihārya vibhūṣitāḥ ।amśukāni ca ramyāṇi pramadāḥ tatra śiśyire ॥5-9-60॥

translations.english: Some women slept pillowed on their arms, laying aside their adornments and others had their garment under the head as pillows and lay in sleep.
